text:
Which of the following options are characteristics of semistructured data? 
You can select more than one option.

answers.answer_text: Semistructured data is a subset of structured (relational) data.
Semistructured data requires strictly defined attributes with atomic data types.
Semistructured is self-describing, usually does not require a schema.
Semistructured data can handle optional attributes and structure variants.
Semistructured data combines content, structure, and design elements.

text: Match the following functions of a WebAPI interface to their definitions. Use the most valid definition.

answers.matching: Request information from a WebAPI with parameters encoded in the URL of the request.
Request information from a WebAPI with parameters encoded in the content of the request.
A server that handles incoming requests and organises communication between the client or network and the data the request wishes to access.
A common format used to respond to web requests which uses a key-value representation similar to python dictionaries.

matching_list: A server that handles incoming requests and organises communication between the client or network and the data the request wishes to access.
A common format used to respond to web requests which uses a tag representation similar to HTML.
A common format used to respond to web requests which uses a key-value representation similar to python dictionaries.
Request information from a WebAPI with parameters encoded in the content of the request.
Request information from a WebAPI with parameters encoded in the URL of the request.

text:
Resources on the Internet are identified using a URL (Uniform Resource Locator).
Which of the options below is not a component of a URL?
Which of the following are common properties of NoSQL databases?

answers.answer_text: Contains sets of fixed structured tuples
Can have a denormalised schema model (i.e. can have more than one data item in a what we would call a single tuple attribute)
Commonly uses a query language other than SQL to query the stored data
Has very loose or delayed schema definition requirements
